static:
    name: Static quality contract
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          # Evidence tests authenticate source bytes at their original producer commits.
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - name: Restore pinned wasm-tools
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: |
            .toolchains/downloads/wasm-tools-*.tar.gz
            .toolchains/wasm-tools
          key: core-wasm-tools-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh') }}
      - name: Install pinned wasm-tools
        run: bash scripts/bootstrap-toolchains.sh --wasm-tools-only
      - name: Install dependencies without lifecycle scripts
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Install C/GMP contract-test headers
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libgmp-dev
      - name: Run inventory, lint, and checked JavaScript
        run: |
          source scripts/env.sh
          npm run env:check:core
          npm run lint
          npm run typecheck

    name: Contract shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/6

          name: core-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/core-shards/core-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          overwrite: true
          retention-days: 7

  quality:
    name: quality
    if: always()
    needs: [static, contract]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out the exact aggregate revision
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 22
      - name: Download every shard manifest
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: core-shard-*-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/core-shards
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Authenticate the complete contract partition
        run: node scripts/check-core-contract-shards.mjs build/core-shards
      - name: Require static quality and every contract shard
        env:
          STATIC_RESULT: ${{ needs.static.result }}
          CONTRACT_RESULT: ${{ needs.contract.result }}
        run: |
          test "$STATIC_RESULT" = success
          test "$CONTRACT_RESULT" = success
